title: Extension of module pairings along a ringed site morphism
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites small relative to a universe $W$ [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], both with finite limits. Let $U:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be continuous and preserve finite limits and covering sieves. Let $R$ and $S$ be sheaves of commutative rings on the respective sites, with a morphism of underlying ring sheaves $a:R\to U_*S$. Use the module sheaf categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], internal sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom] and slice restriction [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Assume that for every $V\in\mathcal C$, the slice site $\mathcal C/V$ has additive sheafification and its sheafification equivalences are exactly the locally bijective maps. Suppose the module direct image $U_*$ has a left adjoint $F$, equipped with its adjunction. Write $\eta_M:M\to U_*FM$ for its adjunction unit. For every pair of $R$-module sheaves $L,P$ and every $R$-linear $b:P\to\mathcal Hom_R(L,R)$, there exists a unique $S$-linear morphism $d:F(P)\to\mathcal Hom_S(F(L),S)$ such that for every $V\in\mathcal C$, $p\in P(V)$ and $m\in L(V)$ one has $d(\eta_P(p))(\eta_L(m))=a_V(b(p)(m))$. Evaluation on either side is over the identity object of the corresponding slice. No finite freeness or invertibility of $d$ is asserted.

proof.text: By the independent-universe localization comparison, a map from (FL)|U(V) to S|U(V) is equivalent to a map L|V → U_V*(S|U(V)). Apply this to the functional b(p), followed by the coefficient ring map. This defines the lift of each local functional, with the required evaluation on global unit sections.

Uniqueness in this localized adjunction proves additivity, scalar linearity and compatibility with restriction of those lifts. They therefore give a module morphism P → U_* Hom(FL,S). Take its adjunct to obtain d. The two adjunction unit equations give the stated evaluation. For uniqueness, global adjunction reduces to equality of local Hom sections, and the localized Hom equivalence detects that equality on all restricted unit sections.

theorem exists_pullback_pairing_transfer
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D] [PreservesFiniteLimits U]
    (_hcover : CoverPreserving J K U)
    [∀ V : C, HasWeakSheafify (J.over V) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    [∀ V : C, (J.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    (hAdj : (pushforward.{max u v w} a).IsRightAdjoint) :
      letI := hAdj
      ∀ (L P : ringedSiteModules.{max u v w}
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
        (b : P ⟶ homObj L (unit _)),
        ∃! d : (pullback a).obj P ⟶ homObj ((pullback a).obj L) (unit _),
          ∀ (V : C) (p : P.val.obj (op V)) (m : L.val.obj (op V)),
            (((d.val.app (op (U.obj V))
              (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction a).unit.app P).val.app (op V) p)).app
                (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (U.obj V))))))
              (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction a).unit.app L).val.app (op V) m) =
                a.hom.app (op V) ((b.val.app (op V) p).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))) m)
